questions.q: Read the passage carefully and answer the questions that follow : Tt is common knowledge that there has been wide deforestation in recent years. According to conservative estimates, five million acres have been denuded of forests. This has brought about widespread climatic change all over the country—  leading to recurring drought and other natural calamities. Erosion of topsoil in the catchment areas has resulted in the tragedy of yearly flooding of our major rivers. And flood control measures have not been effective because those have been limited 1o superficial remedies like building embankments rather than rectifying the root cause by starting a vigorous afforestation drive. Deforestation of our hills, in particular, has led to soil erosion and landslides on unprecedented scale, threatening the survival of some of our popular hill stations. The popular increase has spared the hills. In the towns more and more areas are being cleared 1o make room for houses and roads are being built in the fond hope of carrying the fruits of development io the hinterland. This is inevitable, of course, but it need not have been done indiscriminately, without a thought to the consequences. As things are, the natural drainage of these areas has been upset and water seeping into bare earth has led to slipping and sinking of land. Piped water which is being introduced in hill townships without developing adequate drainage facilities has also added to the threat of rapid erosion. QUESTIONS :
